rules.objective_coverage: Fraction of expectedObjectives found in generated content text (case-insensitive keyword match).
rules.grounding: 1.0 if source_count >= 2 (final mode with research); 0.5 if source_count == 1; 0.0 if no sources when research enabled; 1.0 if baseline mode.
rules.structural_validity: 1.0 if validation_passed; 0.5 if skipped; 0.0 if failed.
rules.efficiency: Normalized inverse of wall_clock_ms capped at 30 minutes (higher is faster).
